answer: Correlation-slashed bonds: every agent posts a bond, and when graders find a cluster whose answers fall through the same narrow prism of phrasing and timing, the whole cluster's bonds are cut together. A farm of 100 sybils then risks 100 bonds on one detection, while an honest agent risks only its own. Genuine diversity is like saffron, costly to fake in bulk; cloned outputs split along shared seams like shale.
